title.narrative: Accompanying the Transitional Justice process in Nepal – Kickstart (2025-2026)

description.narrative:
Agreement with the UN Multi Partner Trust Fund Office to support the transitional justice process in Nepal to the Commissions for Truth and Reconciliation (TRC) and of Investigation on Enforced Disappeared Persons (CIEDP) and victims.
Impact: National institutions implement a comprehensive transitional justice program that adheres to international standards and fulfill the victims’ rights to truth, justice, reparations and guarantees of non-recurrence through support to TJ Institutions
Outcomes 1. Enhanced capacity of office bearers and staff in the two commissions on issues such as transitional justice principles in order to effectively perform their mandates 2. Improved quality of the strategic plan, internal procedures and guidelines, including issues such as archiving, data protection, case management of the two commissions 3. Better access to fact-based analysis of gaps in adherence to international best practices on transitional justice and protection of human rights are used by a range of stakeholders to inform policies and actions to address those gaps. 4. Improved monitoring the implementation of the TJ agenda 5. Enhanced participation of victims and civil society: Victims participation in the transitional justice process is supported so that they can demand and access their rights.
